decision: Defer runtime policy until main frozen prior benchmark and evidence of a reachable consequential followup; no score bonus proposed.

primary_sources.title: Active sequential hypothesis testing
primary_sources.connection: Choose sensing actions adaptively using current hypothesis probabilities while accounting for observation cost and decision error; asymptotic guarantees do not transfer to adversarial Stratego.

primary_sources.title: Experience matters: Information acquisition optimizes probability gain
primary_sources.connection: Distinguishes expected reduction in decision error from entropy reduction. Probability gain is appropriate only for equal-reward category identification; guessing a Flag location is not equivalent to winning a Stratego game.

previous_work_review.lifetime: Bounded fixed penalties preserve expendable units; no information reward. Rejected strength gate.
previous_work_review.corridor: Weak hand-set Flag/Bomb screen priors with reachable beneficiary and fixed progress bonuses. Rejected strength gate.
previous_work_review.followthrough: Local discovered-target material continuation after every plausible enemy reply, minus optimistic blind comparator and sacrifice cost. Rejected strength gate.
previous_work_review.difference: The new potential observation changes the JOINT posterior over global Flag/Bomb/mobile formation, even if the revealed front piece itself has no profitable followup. Fixed source templates supply long-range correlations absent from earlier independent/count priors.

exact_diagnostics.joint: P(observed rank r,Flag origin f)=sum_template posterior(t)*I[t[q]=r,tFlag=f] + uniform-background joint.
exact_diagnostics.flag_entropy_information: H(F) − sum_r P(r) H(F|r). Diagnostic only; not a native-score bonus.
exact_diagnostics.flag_identification_probability_gain: sum_r max_f P(r,F=f) − max_f P(F=f). Expected improvement in the best single Flag-location guess, not game EVSI.
exact_diagnostics.actionable_decision_value: For a finite set of ACTUALLY executable future missions A and a justified common terminal/mission utility U, EVSI=sum_r P(r) max_a E[U(a,H)|r] − max_a E[U(a,H)]. Positive Flag entropy alone is insufficient; the best mission must change and remain legally executable after the probe and opponent reply.

audit.expected_material_net_excluding_terminal: −5 forfiles1/8;−7 forfiles0/9, using unchanged native material values. Flag-capture probability .005 reported separately, not treated as information.
audit.within_opening_probe_choice: Each own opening has either one candidate or two reflected candidates with identical information and material expectations. Identification metrics cannot select a better opening capture among these legal choices.

proposed_future_mechanism: Keep existing tactical evaluation and frozen prior unchanged.

First audit later PUBLIC positions where at least two genuinely different Miner/strong-unit route commitments are currently executable and observation changes which route has better predicted outcome. Use only tracked origins and compatible template/background hypotheses.

Compute conditional mission choice using explicit common terminal/mission outcomes, including probe combat, opportunity cost and enemy reply. Require an unchanged-utility comparison with the best unprobed alternative. Do not convert entropy bits or identification probability into material by a fitted coefficient.

If this executable decision class lacks cheap positive-EVSI examples, stop; do not replace the missing outcome utility with a generic information bonus. Any eventual policy needs a new immutable ID and frozen independent validation.
why_defer: The immediate opening experiments are highly discriminative but almost certainly consume a Scout.
No tested opening has an immediately executable solo Miner Flag route after the probe, even under the optimistic frozen-enemy model. Coordination/route preparation is the missing capability.
Seventy-two strong-unit frontier followups are mostly the same local material mechanism already investigated by followthrough; they do not establish global Flag information value.
The procedural20% prior is approximate and early recognition can be confidently wrong. Do not exploit that uncertainty as assumed ground truth.
limits: This is an exact public opening prior calculation, not a replay of legal complete games or a strength comparison.
Future templates are hypotheses, not enemy truth. The uniform component stays present in all information calculations.
Frozen-opponent reachability ignores enemy replies; failure to find a path is narrower than impossibility after coordinated play.
Own initial army sample is eight fixed source templates, not the full original deployment distribution.
validation: 3 diagnostic tests pass, including all10 front origins×12 rank outcomes matching the unchanged full posterior, entropy/probability nonnegativity and route obstacle/capture semantics.
